caustiq.diagnostics.title: Shader-pack Scan Details
caustiq.diagnostics.no_results: No completed scan results are available yet. Put shader-pack folders or ZIP files in the shaderpacks folder, then rescan.
caustiq.diagnostics.empty: No shader-pack folders or ZIP archives were found. Add a pack to the shaderpacks folder and rescan.
caustiq.diagnostics.no_rejections: No candidates were rejected by the structural scanner.
caustiq.diagnostics.scanning_previous: A rescan is in progress. The entries below are from the last completed scan.
caustiq.diagnostics.failure_previous: The latest refresh failed: %s. Showing the last completed scan.
caustiq.browser.title: Shader Pack Browser
caustiq.browser.search_hint: Search names, filenames, IDs, or source type...
caustiq.browser.empty: No shader packs found. Add a folder or ZIP to shaderpacks and rescan.
caustiq.browser.no_matches: No packs match the current search and source filter. Clear the search or switch the source filter.
caustiq.inspector.title: Shader Pack Details
caustiq.inspector.load_failed: Could not inspect this shader pack: %s
caustiq.inspector.summary: %s shader source file(s) · %s pipeline entry point(s) · %s declared
caustiq.inspector.file_heading: Relative file inventory (paths are relative to shaders/)
caustiq.inspector.empty: No files are available in this shader-pack source.
caustiq.inspector.no_matches: No files match this search and type filter. Clear the search or choose All.
caustiq.diagnostics.guidance.ready: Sodium and Nvidium are detected. This is the required renderer stack for this build.
caustiq.diagnostics.guidance.missing_nvi: Sodium is detected, but Nvidium is missing. Install the pinned Nvidium version required by this branch.
caustiq.diagnostics.guidance.missing_sod: Nvidium is detected without Sodium. Install the pinned Sodium version required by this branch.
caustiq.diagnostics.guidance.missing_bot: The required Sodium + Nvidium renderer stack is not detected. Install both pinned dependencies.
caustiq.diagnostics.shaders_disabled_hin: Shaders are disabled. Enable them in Caustiq Shader Settings before testing a pack.
caustiq.diagnostics.no_selected_pack_hin: No valid pack is selected. Open Browse packs to choose an installed shader pack.
caustiq.diagnostics.scan_not_completed: A completed shader-pack scan is not available yet. Run Rescan to discover installed packs.
caustiq.diagnostics.issue_guidance.acces: Check that the shaderpacks folder and candidate are readable. Close programs that may be holding the file open, correct its permissions, then rescan.
caustiq.diagnostics.issue_guidance.inval: Re-download or re-export the ZIP and verify that it opens as a valid archive. Keep the pack in ZIP form; do not place another archive inside it.
caustiq.diagnostics.issue_guidance.pack_: Keep one shader pack per folder or ZIP. It must contain exactly one shaders/ directory; if the ZIP has one wrapper folder, leave that wrapper intact.
caustiq.diagnostics.issue_guidance.pipel: This source has no recognized shader pipeline entry points. Use an OptiFine/Iris-style pack with files such as final.fsh, composite.fsh, or gbuffers_terrain.vsh under shaders/.
caustiq.diagnostics.issue_guidance.unsaf: Re-export the archive with unique relative paths. Remove absolute paths, ../ traversal entries, and duplicate paths that differ only by letter case.
caustiq.diagnostics.issue_guidance.resou: The pack exceeds a CAUSTIQ safety limit for archive size, expanded size, entry count, or nesting depth. Use a smaller or less deeply nested pack.
caustiq.diagnostics.issue_guidance.unsup: Replace symbolic links with regular files and directories. CAUSTIQ intentionally does not follow links while scanning packs.
caustiq.diagnostics.issue_guidance.inval: Only regular shader-pack folders and ZIP archives are supported. Move a valid folder or .zip into shaderpacks and rescan.
caustiq.diagnostics.issue_guidance.other: The scanner could not classify this failure. Check the game log for more context, then copy the diagnostics report if it persists.
caustiq.diagnostics.issue_details.title: Rejected Shader-pack Candidate
caustiq.diagnostics.issue_details.privac: Only the candidate filename is shown. Full filesystem paths and shader source contents are intentionally hidden.
caustiq.diagnostics.issue_details.scroll: Scroll or use ↑/↓, Page Up/Down, Home/End to read the full details.
